lessons.goal: 從建議信推論寫作目的、對象與可操作的閱讀方法。

questions.evidence: The graduating class leaves advice for next year's reading club. Instead of writing 'Work harder,' Elin writes about a mistake she remembers clearly: choosing an option because it repeated a word from the passage, even though the relationship was wrong.

Choosing by a repeated word despite a wrong relationship.
Copying a whole official paper.

lessons.story:
The graduating class leaves advice for next year's reading club. Instead of writing 'Work harder,' Elin writes about a mistake she remembers clearly: choosing an option because it repeated a word from the passage, even though the relationship was wrong.

She tells the next reader to find a sentence that supports the whole answer, not just one familiar word. She also suggests marking uncertain choices and returning to them after reading the surrounding paragraph. Her letter includes a small example and an explanation of why the tempting option fails.

Elin does not promise that this method will solve every question or predict a grade. She says it helped her notice a specific habit and gives the next reader something to try. At the end, she leaves space for a reply from the future club. Advice, she decides, becomes more useful when another person can test it, adapt it, and add what they discover.
lessons.title: A Letter to Next Year's Reader
